answers.q1: Python with pip in a venv, using the hatchling build backend declared in pyproject.toml. From the repo root run: scripts/install (it creates ./venv, runs `pip install -U pip`, then `pip install -r requirements.txt`, which installs the project editable with extras `-e .[brotli,cli,http2,socks,zstd]`). The equivalent manual form is: python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -U pip && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
answers.q4: scripts/check (CI runs this as its lint step). It runs: ./scripts/sync-version; ruff format httpx tests --diff; mypy httpx tests; ruff check httpx tests. Do not use scripts/lint for CI checks, because it auto-fixes and rewrites files.
